svg.title: The electromagnetic spectrum
svg.desc: Seven regions in order, radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays and gamma rays, each drawn with a wave of shorter wavelength than the one above (illustrative) and one use: TV and radio, phones and satellites, remote controls, seeing and photos, fake-note checks, medical scans, killing cancer cells. An arrow shows frequency rising down the page. All travel at 3.0 × 10^8 m/s in a vacuum. No tier labels.

g.text: Not to scale: wavelength falls down the page
